_source: Option tables of the par-03 user choices. Alternatives are step-2 findings (JLC database and DigiKey queried 2026-11-21, datasheets under datasheets/files/) that parts/out/ does not hold, because it lists only the schematic's current part per line. A cell may contain {REF.field}: analysis/01_parts/figures.py replaces it with that column of the parts/out/availability.csv line holding REF, so the schematic's own part follows a parts/bom.py rerun. Every user-choice ref of parts/decisions.csv must be in some choice's refs (figures.py fails otherwise).

fpga.title: Choice 1: FPGA U30, XC7A35T or XC7A100T
rows: JLC assembles; value C to I (par-04)
about a third of the logic
fpga.consequence: Pin check done: all 256 U30 pins exist on the 35T with the same name, bank and I/O type (AMD package files), so a swap needs no re-route. 35T: cheaper part, 35T bitstream, less logic. 100T: schematic kept, about USD 26 more per board at JLC.
fpga.recommendation: B (100T, I grade, JLC) if the headroom is wanted, else D; I rather than C for the -40 C start and because JLC stocks the 100T only as I.

adc.title: Choice 2: ADC U8, LTC2292 C or I grade
adc.consequence: Either way U8 is consigned from DigiKey. I grade costs USD 7.91 more per part (23.73 for 3). Same QFN-64 package and pinout. The LTC2292 order table is not on file (the file is the LTC2294 sheet), so the codes come from the distributor rows.
adc.recommendation: B, the I grade: matches the -40 to 85 C of the other RF parts, stock 334, 13 week lead.

usbc.title: Choice 3: USB-C receptacle J1 (GCT_USB4105 footprint)
usbc.consequence: A to C share the footprint family. Whether the variants fit the board edge and have the shield tabs and 16 contacts the footprint draws is unconfirmed: no GCT datasheet is on file. For the user to obtain: the GCT USB4105 datasheet.
usbc.recommendation: A (base code, most stock at both sources) once you have saved the GCT datasheet and confirmed the variants.

inductor.title: Choice 4: inductor L5-L7 (SRR6040A-330M, 33 uH)
rows: about 1.0 A against 3.5 A typ (5.1 A max)
inductor.consequence: Datasheet p.18: Isat must exceed the peak current limit (p.5: 3.5 A typ, 5.1 A max). The SRR6040A's listed current (about 1.0 A) is far below that; a short or start-up on a loaded rail saturates it. Which listed current is Isat is not in the JLC text; no Bourns datasheet on file.
inductor.recommendation: do not order the SRR6040A as is. B if the board takes an 11x10 mm body, otherwise D; read each part's Isat first.

assembly.title: Choice 5: parts JLCPCB cannot assemble
rows: you buy and ship; JLC places
B. swap for a JLC-stocked part
e.g. U45 LT6232 C grade (JLC stock 2)
through-hole; QFN-64 and SSOP-16 are not hand work
assembly.consequence: Off JLC: U8 (stock 0), U21, U26-U28, U45 (JLC lists only the C grade), P1/P2/U15 and U30 as the C-grade 100T. CON2 (barrel jack), J2 header and six LEDs have no part number yet.
assembly.recommendation: A for U8, U21, U26-U28, U45 and the SMA connectors; C for CON2 and J2; choose the L5-L7 substitute before ordering.

library.title: Choice 6: is kicad/libs/fmcw3.lib still needed?
rows: a library edit; ideas stay in git
C. delete and drop sym-lib-table entry
library.consequence: It is the live symbol library (20 symbols are placed). The 76 unused retired ideas (AD7266, AD9269, MAX2870 and others) are drawn on by no choice here.
library.recommendation: B later (leave A for now); never C.

tgrade.title: Choice 7: clock buffer U6, PL133-37 temperature grade
tgrade.consequence: Datasheet p.5 Ordering Information lists both, SOT23-6, tape and reel. Same package, so the footprint is unchanged; the TI-R would have to be consigned.
tgrade.recommendation: A, the TC-R, because it is the one JLC stocks; the temperature grade is your choice.

lmr.title: Choice 8: buck U17-U19, LMR51420 variant
lmr.consequence: Datasheet p.3 comparison table; all four are SOT-23 6-pin DDC (p.26), so the package does not choose. The schematic states no frequency or mode. The 33 uH inductor (choice 4) goes with this choice.
lmr.recommendation: A, YF: fixed frequency at light load so no burst tones in the IF band, JLC stock 3148 against 9 needed.

y2.title: Choice 9: oscillator Y2, package and footprint mismatch
rows: {Y2.jlc_package} body; needs a 3.2x2.5 footprint: board change
its datasheet is for you to obtain
y2.consequence: The datasheet (p.1) is for a 3.2x2.5 mm package; the footprint is 2.5x2.0 mm (ECS 2520MV), so they do not match. 400 = 40.000 MHz, B = 1.0 ppm, N = -40 to 85 C, TR = reel.
y2.recommendation: B if its datasheet shows 40 MHz clipped sine, since A changes the layout.
